name: Union
overview: Scripture highlights the strength and blessings found in union, emphasizing that collaboration and companionship provide support and stability. Ecclesiastes teaches that two are better than one because they help each other in times of need, share warmth, and resist adversity together, as a threefold cord is not easily broken. Proverbs reinforces this by showing that plans succeed through many counselors, underscoring the advantage of mutual counsel and partnership. These truths reflect the spiritual union of the righteous, particularly their vital connection with Christ, which secures enduring strength and perseverance.
